title: Scary Movie
tagline: No mercy. No shame. No leftovers.
about: A masked killer picks off a group of teens with a secret, and every horror film going gets sent up on the way.

Hot wings, blue cheese dip, celery.How to make it1.2kg chicken wings, tips off, split1 tbsp baking powder1 tsp salt125ml Frank's RedHot sauce60g butter100g blue cheese, crumbled125g sour cream2 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 lemon4 celery sticks, cut in batonsPat the wings dry, toss with the baking powder and salt and spread on a rack over a tray.Bake at 220°C, turning once, until crisp and deep golden.Melt the butter into the hot sauce in a big bowl.Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, mayo and a squeeze of lemon.Toss the hot wings in the sauce and pile up with the dip and celery.Shorty's basement nachosShorty's crew gets the munchies downstairs. Corn chips, black beans, cheese and jalapeños.How to make it230g bag corn chips400g tin black beans, drained1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp smoked paprika200g grated tasty cheese3 tomatoes, diced1/2 red onion, finely diced1 lime1/2 cup coriander leaves60g pickled jalapeños150g sour creamWarm the beans with the cumin, paprika and a splash of water, mashing about half of them.Mix the tomato, onion, coriander and lime juice with a pinch of salt for the salsa.Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a big ovenproof dish.Bake at 200°C until the cheese is bubbling.Top with salsa, jalapeños and sour cream and get it to the table fast.Shakespeare in Love parmesan popcornBrenda talked all the way through the film. Butter popcorn, parmesan and chilli salt.How to make it150g popping corn3 tbsp vegetable oil60g butter40g parmesan, finely grated1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp sea salt flakesGrind the chilli flakes and salt together.Heat the oil in a big lidded pot, add the corn, cover and shake until the popping slows right down.Melt the butter and pour it over the popcorn, tossing as you go.Toss through the parmesan and chilli salt and tip into a big bowl.Cheese and crackers on the coffee tableRay's still upset there was no final episode.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main CourseSpecial Officer Doofy's sloppy joesDoofy was faking it the whole time. Saucy beef on soft buns, dill pickles, slaw.How to make it600g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced1 green capsicum, finely diced2 garlic cloves, crushed250ml tomato sauce2 tbsp brown sugar1 tbsp yellow mustard1 tbsp cider vinegar125ml water4 soft burger buns200g coleslaw mix3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise4 dill pickles, slicedBrown the mince hard in a big pan, breaking it up, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft.Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, mustard, vinegar and water and simmer until thick and glossy.Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayo and a pinch of salt.Toast the buns, pile on the filling and top with pickles and slaw.I KNOW pumpkin mac and cheeseGreg's locker says I KNOW. Roast pumpkin, three cheeses, crunchy crumb.How to make it600g butternut pumpkin, cubed2 tbsp olive oil400g macaroni50g butter50g plain flour750ml milk200g vintage cheddar, grated100g gruyere, grated40g parmesan, grated1 tsp Dijon mustard60g panko breadcrumbs6 sage leavesRoast the pumpkin in the oil at 210°C until soft and caramel at the edges, then mash half of it.Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the packet time and drain.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Off the heat stir in the cheddar, gruyere, mustard and mashed pumpkin.Fold in the pasta and the pumpkin cubes and tip into a baking dish.Top with the panko, parmesan and sage and bake at 200°C until golden and bubbling.DessertHide-and-seek brownie sundaesCindy can see the killer's feet behind the couch. Fudge brownies, vanilla ice cream, hot fudge.How to make it200g dark chocolate, chopped150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs100g plain flour30g cocoa powder1 L vanilla ice cream150ml thickened cream100g milk chocolate, chopped4 maraschino cherriesMelt the dark chocolate and butter together, then beat in the sugar and the eggs one at a time.Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt and spread in a lined 20cm tin.Bake at 170°C until just set with a fudgy middle, then cool a little.Heat the cream until steaming and stir in the milk chocolate for the hot fudge.Cut warm brownies, add a scoop of ice cream, pour over the fudge and top with a cherry.To ToastGarage fridge micheladasTina went to the garage for beer. Cold lager, lime, hot sauce, chilli salt rim.How to make it4 x 355ml bottles of Mexican lager250ml tomato juice3 limes2 tsp Tabasco1 tbsp sea salt flakes1 tsp chilli powder1 tray iceMix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer, run a lime wedge round 4 glass rims and dip them.Squeeze the limes and mix the juice with the tomato juice and Tabasco.Fill the glasses with ice, add the tomato mix and top slowly with the lager.Ice-cold BudweiserPick up the phone and say it.
